title: Incredible or catastrophic? Jaguar unveils its polarising electric car
summary: Jaguar has launched a new electric vehicle two years after its controversial rebranding, continuing the automaker's shift toward EVs amid polarized market reactions. The polarizing design and strategy reflect the company's bold repositioning in the electric car era. The move demonstrates major automakers' commitment to EV transformation despite consumer skepticism.
content: Two years after JLR relaunched Jaguar into a blizzard of controversy, it has launched its new EV.

zh.title: 令人难以置信还是灾难性的?捷豹推出备受争议的电动车
zh.summary: 捷豹在两年前备受争议的品牌重塑后推出新型电动汽车,继续推进该制造商向电动车的转变,尽管市场反应两极分化。这种极具争议的设计和战略反映了该公司在电动汽车时代的大胆重新定位。这一举措展示了主要汽车制造商对电动汽车转型的承诺,尽管消费者持怀疑态度。

title: Trump isn't ‘completely wrong’: Hormuz disruption is Asia’s problem, says Singapore's foreign minister
summary: Singapore's foreign minister argues that Asian economies dependent on Strait of Hormuz energy shipments should bear greater responsibility for securing the waterway, echoing Trump's recent statements. This reflects ongoing geopolitical debate over burden-sharing for global maritime security. The position highlights divisions between developed and developing nations on defense spending.
content: Trump has said that Asian economies, which are heavily reliant on energy shipped through Hormuz, should shoulder more of the burden of keeping the waterway open.

zh.title: 特朗普并非"完全错误":新加坡外交部长称荷尔木兹海峡中断是亚洲的问题
zh.summary: 新加坡外交部长辩称,依赖霍尔木兹海峡能源运输的亚洲经济体应该承担更多责任来保护这条水道,与特朗普最近的言论相呼应。这反映了关于全球海上安全负担分担的持续地缘政治辩论。这一立场突出了发达国家和发展中国家在国防开支上的分歧。

title: Trillions are being ‘wasted’ on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He’s betting on what comes next
summary: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes contends that trillions are being wasted on overbuilt AI infrastructure and is betting a market crash will trigger cryptocurrency gains. His criticism reflects skepticism about current AI spending sustainability and valuation levels. Hayes's stance highlights concerns about whether AI investment matches actual economic returns.
content: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes says the AI infrastructure boom is being overbuilt and is betting an eventual crash and bailout will send crypto higher.

zh.title: 数万亿美元在AI热潮中被'浪费'，阿瑟·海耶斯如此说，他正押注下一步会发生什么
zh.summary: 前BitMEX首席执行官阿瑟·海耶斯主张，数万亿美元被浪费在过度建设的AI基础设施上，他正押注市场崩盘将引发加密货币收益。他的批评反映了对当前AI支出可持续性和估值水平的怀疑。海耶斯的立场凸显了人们对AI投资是否与实际经济回报相匹配的担忧。
